args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks – rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the latest deploy, checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an 18% error rate. (The v2.3.1-rc build had also been unhealthy in staging.) The SRE agent rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback was approved and completed in all three regions. Next steps: confirm health and error rate stay stable on v2.3.0, find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure, and keep v2.3.1 out of production until it is fixed.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident.

- **What went wrong:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It was failing health checks with an error rate of about 18%. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also failed in staging before it reached production.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. A human approver signed off on the rollback, and all three regions now run v2.3.0. A status check afterwards shows the service is healthy, with the error rate down to about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) is open, and the on-call engineer has been paged. It describes the failure, the rollback and next steps: keep an eye on v2.3.0, find out why v2.3.1 failed, and don't redeploy v2.3.1 until it's fixed.
